content.text:
The fix is in `src/diff/json.ts`. `canonicalize` checked for arrays before calling `toJSON()`, so it got the two cases wrong:

- An object whose `toJSON()` returned an array was turned into an object with keys `"0"`, `"1"`, ….
- An array with its own `toJSON()` never had it called, so its elements were diffed instead.

I moved the `toJSON()` call ahead of the array check, so the result of `toJSON()` is what gets classified. That matches `JSON.stringify`, which also calls `toJSON` before deciding how to serialize.

I added three regression tests to `test/diff/json.js`:
- an object whose `toJSON()` returns an array, checked against the exact expected diff;
- two objects whose `toJSON()` return the same array, which should produce no differences;
- an array with a `toJSON()` method, which should diff as `"aaa"` versus `"aaa"`.

I rebuilt `libesm/` and ran the full mocha suite: 313 passing, 0 failing. I did not run the new tests against the unfixed code, so I haven't seen them fail before the change.
